title: OFSCP Discoverable Feed Subscription Request (v0.1)
description: Body of POST /api/groups/{groupId}/channels/{channelId}/discoverable/subscriptions (§8.4). Provider-signed (§8.1) by the subscribing provider. The hub MUST require the `callback` host to match the signing provider's domain.

callback.description: Where feed pushes are delivered. Its host MUST match the signing provider's domain.

leaseSeconds.description: Requested subscription lifetime in seconds. The hub MAY grant a shorter lease (RECOMMENDED cap ≤ 7 days) and returns the granted value during verification.
